arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import os, signal, ctypes, time, sys
pid = os.fork()
if pid == 0:
    libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
    print('child dumpable set:', libc.prctl(4,0,0,0,0), flush=True)
    time.sleep(30)
    os._exit(0)
time.sleep(1)
try:
    os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
    print('kill ok')
except OSError as e:
    print('kill failed', e)
print(os.waitpid(pid,0))
EOF
